name: g3 NetworX UG & Co. KG
notes:
IPv6-only network operated by g3 NetworX UG (haftungsbeschränkt) & Co. KG, AS218229.

Address space and routing:
- Originated aggregate: 2a0c:9a40:e080::/48; only this exact /48 is announced externally.
- Valid RPKI ROA and RIPE route6 object for origin AS218229.
- IRR AS-SET: RIPE::AS218229:AS-G3NETWORX. It contains only our own origin AS218229; no downstream autonomous systems are included.
- Routing infrastructure: Frankfurt am Main, Germany, and Amsterdam, Netherlands. Customer and internal services are delivered over routed, encrypted tunnels.

IPv6 transit:
- Virtua.Cloud, AS35661, RTFRA1: first reserve transit behind RTAMS1.
- LowPing NL, AS215296, RTAMS1 (Amsterdam): primary IPv6 transit since 2026-11-05. The BGP default route is accepted and preferred throughout our backbone; exports contain only our exact /48 without additional prepends. Direct own-prefix reachability and the site paths have been validated. Frankfurt remains available as reserve.
- iFOG, AS34927, RTFRA3: additional transit.
- Senko Digital, AS213520, RTFRA2: configured reserve transit. BGP is established and the /48 is advertised; commissioning remains in progress because forwarding with our own prefix was still failing in direct tests on 2026-11-03. This path is not yet released as a production egress.

Public peering:
- Open IPv6 peering policy; please contact our peering team to coordinate a session.
- FogIXP Europe: 1 Gbps virtual port provisioned through iFOG on RTFRA3 (Frankfurt). Assigned IPv6 peering address: 2001:7f8:ca:1::21:8229:1. Operational IPv6 peering with redundant route-server sessions to AS47498 (RS1 and RS2). Imports accept only RPKI-valid global IPv6 prefixes; exports are restricted to our exact /48. The validated routes are available throughout our internal backbone.
- Frys-IX (Amsterdam): operational virtual 1 Gbps access through LowPing NL on RTAMS1 since 2026-11-05; IPv6 peering address 2001:7f8:10f::3:5475:128/64. Both IPv6 route-server sessions to AS56393 (2001:7f8:10f::dc49:1 and 2001:7f8:10f::dc49:2) are established. Imports accept only RPKI-valid global IPv6 prefixes through /48; exports contain only our exact locally originated /48. Validated peering routes are distributed throughout our internal backbone.
- Transit BGP sessions listed above are not IXP memberships. Frys-IX is delivered through a reseller; no direct rack or facility presence is claimed.

Contacts:

Technical: mp@g3networx.de

AS218210 / MPL-NET is a separate personal network and is not part of this PeeringDB network record.
